app_info.subtitle: Plan an operations pilot
app_info.description: SuperMega Pilot helps businesses explore current SuperMega operating workflows and turn one selected workflow into a bounded draft pilot brief with measurements, evidence requirements, and human approval boundaries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches a bundled public workflow catalogue and does not create or update records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns public SuperMega links without writing to external systems or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one bundled public workflow record and does not modify any source or account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns a canonical public link without sending data to third parties or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes an in-memory draft from bounded inputs and does not persist or modify data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send, publish, take payment, or call an external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite data; the result is draft-only and keeps consequential actions human-approved.

test_cases.description: Find Commerce workflows for orders and stock.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the SuperMega workflows for turning chat orders into controlled stock and fulfilment records.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant public Commerce catalogue items with canonical SuperMega links.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the current SuperMega Production workflow, modules, templates, measurement, and readiness gate.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current public Production workflow and clearly states its present readiness gate.

test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare a 14-day Social commerce pilot to reduce order handling time. We currently coordinate through chat.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders a draft-only pilot brief with workflow stages, baseline measurement, acceptance evidence, and human approval boundaries.

test_cases.description: Prepare a retail and wholesale pilot.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare a 7-day Retail and wholesale pilot to reduce pick-to-close time and stock variance. Our current process is mixed.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders a bounded Commerce pilot with the selected workflow, measurement, evidence requirements, and human approval boundary.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create a 30-day Maintenance and downtime pilot from our spreadsheet process, focused on reducing downtime and proving return-to-service evidence.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders a maintenance pilot with the correct workflow, measurement, evidence requirements, and owner decisions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for private live order lookup.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Look up the live payment and delivery status for customer order 1042.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot access customer workspaces or live order records.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for external marketing sends.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send this promotion to every lead in my pipeline now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot access leads or send external messages.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for local filesystem actions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete old build folders from my laptop and run the deployment command.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no filesystem, shell, or deployment capability.
